candidates.name: langgraph
candidates.selection_reason: The first public interaction/proposal slice is deterministic contract validation only; adding an orchestration runtime has no measured acceptance advantage and would expand the dependency surface.

candidates.name: open-policy-agent
candidates.selection_reason: A separate policy engine is not needed to establish the first deterministic non-authorizing proposal boundary; keep OPA as a candidate until an external policy-decision interface has a measured need.

selection_policy: Do not add an orchestration or policy runtime until it materially outperforms or enables a capability the minimal deterministic boundary cannot provide. Candidate licenses alone are not distribution approval.
